simple.meaning: אָדֹם (ʼâdôm) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “rosy.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 25:30. The surrounding context includes blood, Torah, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָדֹם (H122) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אָדֹם (ʼâdôm) / H122 is traced through Genesis 25:30, Numbers 19:2, 2 Kings 3:22, Song of Songs 5:10 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H122. adom אָדֹם adjective red — ׳א Isa 63:2 ; Zech 1:8 + Gen 25:30 (twice in verse), see below; אָדוֺם Song 5:10 ; feminine אֲדֻמָּה Num 19:2 , plural אֲדֻמִּים 2Kin 3:22 2 t.; — ruddy, red , of man Song 5:10 ; horse Zech 1:8 (twice in verse) (|| שָׂרֹק compare Assyrian Dl W 87 ) 6:2 (|| שָׁחֹר ); heifer Num 19:2 ; water 2Kin 3:22 ( ׳א כַּדָּם ); compare as substantive red, redness on garment Isa 63:2 ; הָאָדֹם = the (red) lentils Gen 25:30 (twice in verse), but read הָאֱדֹם see below; compare also מַעֲלֶה .
